thread:
Elaine Park: Heads-up: prepping relnotes for the next docs deploy. Main items: adaptive batching doc, SDK 1.4 param changes, and a short migration note for streaming embeddings. Need volunteers for: quickstart snippet sweep, migration guide draft, and a final linkcheck.
Matt G.: I can take the quickstart and snippets. Which languages first?
Elaine Park: Python + JS first. Add a short note under each snippet about the new timeout_ms param and stream flag. Go later if we have cycles.
Samir: I'll draft the migration guide and the known-issues section (streaming partial embeddings + backpressure). Will add repro steps and a temporary workaround.
Olivia: Found two broken links in the embeddings flow: one redirect and one old path to /docs/examples/embed-batch. I'll open a PR for link fixes and update the redirects file.
docs-bot: TASKS: [ ] relnotes.md draft in /docs/releases, [ ] snippets updated (py/js), [ ] migration guide PR, [ ] linkcheck green.
Matt G.: Example snippet to update:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.call('gpt-4-mini', prompt='Summarize this')
```
should become
```
resp = c.call('gpt-4-mini', prompt='Summarize this', timeout_ms=15000, stream=False)
```
Matt G.: I'll also add a streaming chat example with generator pattern and a short note about partial outputs.
Samir: PR #460 opened: migration-guide + known-issues. Added a short troubleshooting section and a note to revert to non-streaming for embeddings if you see length mismatch.
Olivia: PR #461 (linkfix): fixed redirect for /docs/embeddings/streaming and updated internal links to /docs/examples/embed-batch. Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview/461 — needs QA.
Matt G.: Snippets PR #462 with updated tests. Left TODO for Go example. Running local linkcheck now and posting results.
Matt G.: linkcheck output: two minor warnings (anchor mismatch on chat streaming); will fix in next commit.
Elaine Park: Great progress. I'll stitch relnotes bullets from PR descriptions and write a short "what changed" blurb for the top of the release page. Please add a one-line summary in your PR bodies so I can copy them.
Samir: Added summary: "Migration: streaming embedding behavior clarified; workaround for partial-embeddings included."
Olivia: Added summary: "Fixed redirects and updated embed examples to point to batch examples."
Matt G.: Added summary: "Updated quickstart snippets for SDK 1.4: timeout_ms and stream flags; added streaming chat pattern."
Elaine Park: Target merge by tomorrow 9am PT. If any of you will be blocked, ping here and tag @docs-bot. :rocket:
Olivia: Will run one more preview check and mark QA done if green.
Samir: Will follow up with a small patch if QA finds anything.
Matt G.: Ok, aiming to push go snippets after merges.
Elaine Park: Thanks team — relnotes draft will be in /docs/releases/3267890123-relnotes-draft.md once I finish composing the bullets.
